name: FRC IFRS S1/S2 Adoption Roadmap (amended February 2026)
changelog: Initial pack for the amended sustainability reporting roadmap. Phase 3A makes IFRS S1/S2 mandatory for all PIEs for periods beginning 1 January 2028; Phase 3B covers SMEs (turnover ≤ ₦500m and total assets ≤ ₦200m) from 1 January 2030; Phase 4 covers the public sector under IPSASB SRS 1 from 1 January 2028. Transition reliefs include climate-first reporting, Scope 3 deferral and alternative GHG methods aligned to the GHG Protocol. Every date, threshold and penalty in this pack is drawn from the phase-8 research brief and has NOT been confirmed against the regulator’s primary document. The pack ships unverified: records are usable internally but excluded from generated regulatory submissions until a person verifies them (rule R10).

framework.name: FRC IFRS S1/S2 Adoption Roadmap
framework.description: Phased adoption of IFRS S1 and S2 sustainability disclosure standards in Nigeria, with three pre-reporting filing stages before the first mandatory reporting period.

requirements.title: Phase 3A — mandatory adoption by all PIEs
requirements.guidance: Periods beginning on or after 1 January 2028.

requirements.title: Phase 3B — SMEs
requirements.guidance: Turnover ≤ ₦500m and total assets ≤ ₦200m; periods beginning on or after 1 January 2030.

requirements.title: Phase 4 — public sector (IPSASB SRS 1)
requirements.guidance: Periods beginning on or after 1 January 2028.

requirements.title: Stage 1 pre-reporting filing
requirements.guidance: Three months before the financial year: board resolution, gap analysis and implementation plan.

requirements.title: Stage 2 pre-reporting filing
requirements.guidance: Within three months of the start of the year: sustainability disclosure policies, materiality assessment, governance structure evidence and board training proof.

requirements.title: Stage 3 pre-reporting filing
requirements.guidance: Within six months of the start of the year: professional registration evidence, risk management framework, scenario analysis models, metrics and targets.

obligations.title: Stage 1 pre-reporting filing
obligations.description: Board resolution, gap analysis and implementation plan, filed three months before the start of the financial year.
obligations.legal_reference: FRC IFRS S1/S2 adoption roadmap (amended February 2026)

obligations.title: Stage 2 pre-reporting filing
obligations.description: Sustainability disclosure policies, materiality assessment, governance structure evidence and board training proof, filed within three months of the start of the year.
obligations.legal_reference: FRC IFRS S1/S2 adoption roadmap (amended February 2026)

obligations.title: Stage 3 pre-reporting filing
obligations.description: Professional registration evidence, risk management framework, scenario analysis models, and metrics and targets, filed within six months of the start of the year.
obligations.legal_reference: FRC IFRS S1/S2 adoption roadmap (amended February 2026)

obligations.title: IFRS S1/S2 sustainability disclosures in the annual report
obligations.description: Sustainability-related financial disclosures under IFRS S1 and climate disclosures under IFRS S2, published with the annual report for periods beginning on or after 1 January 2028.
obligations.legal_reference: FRC IFRS S1/S2 adoption roadmap (amended February 2026), Phase 3A
